resolved_conflicts.explanation: OpenStreetMap calls the spot Raymond Lookout Tower; the register lists Raymond as a possible other name. The coordinates match, so we treat them as one tower.

notes_for_editor: Only the register and OpenStreetMap were read. No build date, staffing or fire history found. The Raymond name may refer to the town rather than a site name. A search turned up an unrelated OSHA report on a 1997 TV antenna tower collapse in Raymond, Mississippi; not used. Access level 'restricted' is a judgment from the register's still-in-use note, not a stated rule.
